title: MacroPulse Alert
message:
ISM Services PMI (Aug) 55.4 vs 54.3 est, 54.1 prior — strongest beat in months, 26th straight expansion, reinforces Sep 16 hike case.
Oil WTI steady ~$91 after 9% 3-day surge; Trump says Iran strikes 'brief' — Hormuz risk still live, energy inflation sticking.
BTC ETF Aug inflows $3.52B (best month 2026); BTC +1% today near $78,500, range-bound as hike odds hold at 66%.
